todo_line: - [ ] 008E Introduce and focused-test one fresh-authorized delivery-detail query with exact conversation, access, represented-Person and independently committed member-status/staff-reason delivery interests.

validation.evidence: 58 tests, 0 failures; covers the new delivery query, accepted conversation-detail boundary, and committed read-model source adapter.

notes: Added the distinct :member_message_delivery descriptor on :delivery_detail with stable club_id, message_id, and authenticated_email inputs. Its exact result keys are page_title, selected_club, current_member, message, conversation_audience, sender_name, delivery_message_id, member_email_deliverys, member_email_delivery_ids, member_email_delivery_count, member_email_delivery_summary, and member_email_delivery_groups. Each load composes MemberMessageDetailQuery.load/3, which normalizes primary or attached identity email, rereads active clubs and current Person/member, resolves the conversation audience, and rechecks authoritative conversation access while preserving :forbidden versus :not_found. Interests cover the selected Club, current membership and Person, exact Person/club relationship and group participation, conversation/access, requested and root messages, root message delivery collection, exact delivery IDs, and displayed sender/recipient Persons with deterministic deduplication. Focused proof covers routed replies retaining root delivery scope, exact member/staff projector notification matching and unrelated-message isolation, independently changing member status and staff reason with fresh-read convergence, zero-recipient presentation, and exclusion of conversation entries, follow state, raw delivery rows, route/disclosure/flash/navigation state. The initial TDD run failed as expected with 7 tests and 7 failures because the query module was absent; the implementation then passed all focused checks. No LiveView wiring, adapter, existing detail-query contract, projector, schema, command, event, plan, todo, matrix, ADR, acceptance feature, or other delivery metadata changed; task 008E remains unchecked.
